name: 47081-lowconcdecode-qwen35-08b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration: a hybrid text backbone (24 layers, 18 linear-attention + 6 full-attention, hidden 1024, 8 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256, bf16) behind a vision tower this text-only workload never uses; all of it readable from the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 120 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), greedy (`temperature: 0.0`), prompt exactly 8192 tokens and output exactly 1024 tokens with `ignore_eos`, text only.
purpose: A long-document summarizer on a compact Qwen model, four concurrent streams of 8k-token prompts, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line for this item. Values are pinned rather than inherited so a default
# cannot resolve differently between runs.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Clears the longest request (8192 prompt + 1024 output = 9216 tokens) with room.
max-model-len: 10240

# Equal to the declared concurrency: a closed loop of 4 never has a fifth request in flight.
max-num-seqs: 4

# Exactly one prompt's worth, so an 8192-token prefill is ONE scheduler step, not N chunks.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# This checkpoint carries a vision tower and this workload is text only, so memory profiling would
# push a max-size synthetic image batch through an encoder no request ever touches. Skipping it
# takes minutes off engine construction, and the only quantity it changes is the KV estimate --
# the run needs 4 x 10240 tokens of KV against a pool two orders of magnitude larger.
skip-mm-profiling: true

# LOAD-BEARING: this engine defaults prefix caching ON. Forced off so every request does its own
# full 8192-token prefill and no run is helped by two synthetic prompts sharing a prefix.
enable-prefix-caching: false
